page_topic: Booking.com, Airbnb and hotel message scams: how to tell a fake payment request
method: Pages downloaded and quotes checked as exact substrings where possible; otherwise quotes taken from WebFetch extraction (flagged). Quotes <=25 words.

facts.statement: Booking.com says it will never ask travellers to share credit card details by email, phone, text or WhatsApp.
facts.quote: We'll never ask you to share credit card details by email, over the phone, through text or WhatsApp.
